links.outcome: Semantic similarity (BERTScore) of generated ECG impressions to reference reports, with vs without guide grounding
links.effect: Average BERTScore rose from 0.818 to 0.953 versus the CNN+Grad-CAM+MLLM baseline without the guide, while classification performance stayed competitive.
links.quote: In particular, our method increases the average BERTScore of generated impressions from 0.818 to 0.953 relative to a strong CNN+Grad-CAM+MLLM baseline, indicat- ing closer alignment with reference reports.

screen.reason: The study tests the specific safeguard/deployment practice of injecting distilled clinical guidelines (guide grounding) into an MLLM prompt pipeline to reduce hallucinations and improve factual alignment in ECG report generation compared to a baseline without grounding.
